Today, I'm teaching you how to make Cheonggukjang (청국장). Cheonggukjang is fermented soybeans. It contains both whole and broken soybeans - and is made by fermented boiled soybeans for 2-3 days. It's famous for its very pungent smell when cooked. Even many Koreans are wary of it. But Daniel loves it! And he'll share with you his recipe - that tastes amazing. It's similar to cheonggukjang stews you'll find at select Korean BBQ restaurants in Seoul (on their side menu). Sharp, flavorful and packed with umami. This is our Cheonggukjang recipe!

ਇੱਕ ਨਵਾਂ ਗੁਆਂਢੀ ਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ! ਉਦੋਂ ਤੋਂ... ਸਾਡੇ 'ਤੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਬਹੁਤ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਦਬਾਅ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸਾਡੀ ਸ਼ੈਲੀ ਜਾਣਦੇ ਹੋ... ਸਾਨੂੰ ਚੰਗਾ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਵੇਗਾ (lol!)। ਅੱਜ, ਅਸੀਂ ਇੱਕ ਅਜਿਹੀ ਵਿਅੰਜਨ ਪੇਸ਼ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ 'ਤੇ ਅਸੀਂ ਪਿਛਲੇ 3 ਮਹੀਨਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਕਰਦੇ ਆ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਾਡਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਪਰਿਵਾਰਕ ਮੈਂਬਰ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਕੋਰੀਅਨ ਮਿੱਟੀ ਦੇ ਘੜੇ ਵਾਲਾ ਚੌਲ ਹੈ - ਸੋਟਬਾਪ!! ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ। ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਗੱਲ ਇਹ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਜਦੋਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਖਾਣੇ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਈਕ੍ਰੋਵੇਵ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਕਾਉਂਦੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਇਸਦਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਵੀ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ - ਅਗਲੇ ਦਿਨ... ਸਾਨੂੰ ਵਿਅੰਜਨ ਅਤੇ ਖੁਸ਼ਖਬਰੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਆਂਢੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਪਵੇਗੀ ;-)

Today, I'm teaching you how to make Cheonggukjang (청국장). Cheonggukjang is fermented soybeans. It contains both whole and broken soybeans - and is made by fermented boiled soybeans for 2-3 days. It's famous for its very pungent smell when cooked. Even many Koreans are wary of it. But Daniel loves it! And he'll share with you his recipe - that tastes amazing. It's similar to cheonggukjang stews you'll find at select Korean BBQ restaurants in Seoul (on their side menu). Sharp, flavorful and packed with umami. This is our Cheonggukjang recipe!

Today, I'm teaching you how to make Cheonggukjang (청국장). Cheonggukjang is fermented soybeans. It contains both whole and broken soybeans - and is made by fermented boiled soybeans for 2-3 days. It's famous for its very pungent smell when cooked. Even many Koreans are wary of it. But Daniel loves it! And he'll share with you his recipe - that tastes amazing. It's similar to cheonggukjang stews you'll find at select Korean BBQ restaurants in Seoul (on their side menu). Sharp, flavorful and packed with umami. This is our Cheonggukjang recipe!

Today, we're introducing you to a simple simple Radish Bibimbap (무생채 비빔밥) recipe. This is a delicious (yet underrated) recipe we saw on The Easy Chan. It's essentially the famous Spicy Korean Radish (무생채), but made with a stronger, bolder, "street-food" marinade. snippet.description:

Neighbors - today, we're making Braised Pork over Rice. We'll sear a whole piece of pork belly (통삼겹살), then braise it a flavored soy sauce. In Japan, its called buta kakuni - but we take our spin on it!  Throw in some garlic cloves, soft-boiled eggs and bok-choy into the soy sauce mixture. Simmer it away. Then lay the soft, tender pork pieces over some rice - and you got yourself a gourmet rice plate. Ah, you're in for a treat today!

Today, we show you how to make the ultimate doenjang jjigae! It's called Chadol Doenjang Jjigae (차돌박이 된장찌개). Chadolbaegi is thinly sliced beef brisket - it's the one you order at Korean BBQ restaurants. We'll add in a few strips, along with a few key ingredients to transform a traditional soybean stew into a rich, umami-packed doenjang jjigae - similar to the ones you get at Korean BBQ restaurants! Today, we are making Korean Dallae Ganjang (Wild Chive Soy Sauce) and a variety of simple jeon (savory pancakes). The sauce is perfect for days when you don't have much of an appetite. Spread it over rice & mix it it for a simple bibimbap. Or use it a dip for single-ingredient, savory pancakes. Together, they taste absolutely wonderful! One of the best tasting recipes thus far!
